entities.summary: Ryan Jeffrey Archibald is a field hockey player from New Zealand, who earned his first cap for the national team, nicknamed The Black Sticks, in 1997 against Malaysia. Currently he is a player for Somerville Hockey Club. Ryan Archibald was a athletes & competitors from Auckland (b. 1980-09-01, Auckland). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
